title: Micro Raiders : Need testers for my extraction fantasy browser game (claude code)
author: UnknownCitizen7
selftext:
Hi guys!

I'm looking for a few testers for my top-down pixel art extraction looter playable directly in the browser:

\> Go into a random dungeon, fight monsters and other players, loot, and get out alive with your gear.

It’s completely free btw.

\*\*What's in it so far:\*\*

\- PvPvE matches (2 to 5 players, 20 min), plus a temporary PvE mode you can play solo or as a duo

\- The Pit: waves of enemies, round after round, with a leaderboard

\- 3 classes (warrior, archer, mage), each with 3 skills and its own gear

\- Randomly generated dungeons, with chests and corpses to search, traps and a boss

\- Stealth: darkness hides you, your lantern gives you away, monsters hear your steps

\- Loot in 4 rarities, gems to socket, gear that wears out and needs repairs

\- Gathering (plants, mushrooms, ore, fishing) and crafting: potions, grenades, repairs, gem enchanting

\- A hub with a stash, a merchant with a rotating shop, daily and weekly missions, achievements and titles

\- Chat, friends, private messages, profiles, and duo parties

\- English and French

I'm a solo dev and I build it with Claude Code and godot. I've also been trying a few pixel art generators, but honestly the results aren't great so far. If anyone knows good ones.

It's in closed alpha:

I need people to find bugs and tell me what feels off. There are about 30 spots open right now.

Join the Discord and I'll send you one:

[https://discord.gg/UvwPtXTcDg](https://discord.gg/UvwPtXTcDg), or just DM me here on Reddit.

comments.author: One_Construction424
comments.body: Seems like i am the first to click your page, since there is a weird scan for maleware etc. - no clue where you host but that makes your website sus af

replies.author: UnknownCitizen7
replies.body: Apparently, the URL shortener was compromised. You can't trust anyone anymore—it was the #1 result on Google. I’ve switched to a different one.

replies.author: One_Construction424
replies.body: why would you use a URL shortener on your website?

replies.author: UnknownCitizen7
replies.body:
Because I don’t have a dedicated URL yet, and it seems Reddit blocks certain domains, I’m using a URL shortener.

The first one I used worked fine at the start—which is why you were the first to provide feedback—but they changed it after a few hours.

This time, I’ve gone with a much more popular one.

replies.author: One_Construction424
replies.body: URL Shortener are really sus, you should list it like Link\[.\]com
